interpretation: The fixed 2025 paper centres preserve substantially more spectral information than the three-band control. Both seven and eight bands have low absolute CIEDE2000 error on measured Velvia 100F target spectra and on the independent CAVE reflectance stress population.

The paper7 compiler improves fresh CAVE p95 error by 78.54% and beats the equal-spacing diagnostic, while reversed band order fails strongly. The explicit nonnegative compiler is bounded and exactly clear-normalized without clipping.

The frozen programme nevertheless required at least 75% fresh CAVE median improvement over RGB3. The observed 64.74% fails that gate. The ideal-centre abstraction therefore closes under this contract; its strong development signal is retained without promotion or threshold rescue.

The result does not test numeric commercial LED SPDs, sensor sensitivity, actual scanner geometry or a released film MSI cube. A future successor requires one of those new identifying observations rather than more bands, a larger model or reuse of the same populations.
